pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-large-batch-07
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 previously undecompiled PAL resident functions (9,036 bytes). Two reconstructions used public engine-family interface references. Immutable repositories, commits, source files and functions are credited in config/pal/crossgame_sources.tsv and the source comments.

pullRequests.author: LucienTo
pullRequests.head: matches-batch-1
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C for 26 NTSC-U functions that had no US source yet: one libgraph routine in
core.text (func_001270C0, sceGsSyncV, built @ee29 -O2 -G0) and 25 small resident game
functions in src/game/. One commit per function, then one commit regenerating the maps and
reports.

range-checked table lookups), flag setters and clears, lazy-init getters, small call sequences, two

pullRequests.author: Sumaiter
pullRequests.head: decomp/pal-codex-parallel-02
pullRequests.body:
Adds matching C implementations for 50 previously undecompiled PAL resident functions (11,004 bytes), independently reconstructed against this game's PAL retail code.
The batch covers menu/list state updates, resource dispatch, binary-data loading and player/interface helpers.
